findings.highlight: It’s usually packed with students, but not in this cold winter air.
findings.evidenceJa: 夏場なら生徒たちで賑わう屋上も、冬の寒さの前には
findings.governingReading: The rooftop is busy with students in summer, but winter cold empties it.
findings.explanation: Usually generalizes a specifically seasonal contrast.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka, shivering under cover.
findings.evidenceJa: 寒そうに、物陰で縮こまっている遠坂
findings.governingReading: Rin huddles in a sheltered corner, visibly cold.
findings.explanation: Under cover is spatially vague and omits her contracted posture.

findings.highlight: the coffee I bought at the stand
findings.evidenceJa: ホットの缶コーヒー
findings.governingReading: Shirou brought hot canned coffee from the school shop.
findings.explanation: The temperature and canned form that make it a hand-warmer disappear.

findings.highlight: I pass Tohsaka and hand her the coffee.
findings.evidenceJa: 缶コーヒーを渡しながら物陰に入っていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou hands Rin the coffee while moving into shelter.
findings.explanation: Pass Tohsaka inserts walking past her and confuses the simultaneous action.

findings.highlight: I like milk teas.
findings.evidenceJa: インスタントならミルクティー
findings.governingReading: For instant tea, Rin specifies milk tea.
findings.explanation: Plural milk teas changes the requested preparation into a category of drinks.

findings.highlight: The value of the gratitude goes down if it’s anything else
findings.evidenceJa: それ以外はありがたみがランクダウンする
findings.governingReading: Anything else lowers how grateful Rin will be by one rank.
findings.explanation: Value of the gratitude is Japanese-shaped and blunts her mock ranking language.

findings.highlight: that utterly amazed expression
findings.evidenceJa: 露骨に呆れた顔
findings.governingReading: Rin gives Shirou an openly exasperated look.
findings.explanation: Amazed replaces weary disbelief with surprise.

findings.highlight: I’ve heard that I’m an inexperienced magus too many times.
findings.evidenceJa: 耳にタコだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the repeated criticism has raised calluses on his ears.
findings.explanation: The meaning survives, but the bodily idiom and comic complaint disappear.

findings.highlight: it will pretty much encircle the whole school
findings.evidenceJa: 発動すれば学校の敷地をほぼ包み込む
findings.governingReading: If activated, the field will cover almost the entire school grounds.
findings.explanation: The conditional activation state disappears, making the full coverage sound current.

findings.highlight: steals blood and meat
findings.evidenceJa: 血肉を奪うタイプ
findings.governingReading: The field strips blood and flesh from humans inside it.
findings.explanation: Meat is a crude culinary literalism for human flesh.

findings.highlight: I felt a bit strange
findings.evidenceJa: なんとも言えない違和感
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls an indefinable sense that something was wrong.
findings.explanation: Felt a bit strange shifts the disturbance into his own mild bodily state.

findings.highlight: Sothere’s a Master at this school
findings.evidenceJa: つまり学校に、マスターがいる
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes a Master is present at school.
findings.explanation: A missing boundary fuses So and there’s.

findings.highlight: My relaxed feelings go tense.
findings.evidenceJa: 弛緩していた意識が引き締まる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s lax awareness snaps into focus.
findings.explanation: Feelings changes attentional readiness into emotion and reads unnaturally.

findings.highlight: someone with an incomplete knowledge of magic
findings.evidenceJa: 半端に魔術を知ってる人間
findings.governingReading: Rin suspects someone with partial knowledge of magecraft.
findings.explanation: Magic collapses the work’s technical magecraft distinction.

findings.highlight: they’re bound to become intimate
findings.evidenceJa: どうしても懇意になるものなのよ
findings.governingReading: Two magus lineages rooted in one small region inevitably establish close relations.
findings.explanation: Intimate carries romantic or sexual force not present in the institutional relationship.

findings.highlight: a lone wolf who alienated himself from the Association
findings.evidenceJa: 協会から離反した一匹狼だったんでしょうね
findings.governingReading: Rin speculates Kiritsugu was a lone wolf who broke with or defected from the Association.
findings.explanation: Alienated himself describes social estrangement rather than organizational defection.

findings.highlight: He must have happened to like this city and decided to live in it
findings.evidenceJa: たまたまこの町が気に入って根を下ろしたんだろうけど
findings.governingReading: Rin conjectures that Kiritsugu happened to like the town and put down roots.
findings.explanation: Must hardens her speculative reconstruction of his history.

findings.highlight: WWhat do you mean
findings.evidenceJa: ななんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers his alarm at Rin’s collection threat.
findings.explanation: The opening is fused into WWhat.

findings.highlight: when you mature
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎が一人前になったら
findings.governingReading: When Shirou becomes a fully qualified magus, Rin jokingly plans to collect.
findings.explanation: Mature turns professional qualification into general personal adulthood.

findings.highlight: he lived a long time
findings.evidenceJa: 天寿は全うしたんだし
findings.governingReading: Rin claims her father completed his allotted natural lifespan.
findings.explanation: Living a long time omits the explicit assertion that his death followed a full natural span.

findings.highlight: almost at the level of sorcery
findings.evidenceJa: ほとんど魔法の領域
findings.governingReading: The field’s sophistication approaches the domain of true Magic.
findings.explanation: Sorcery again collapses the defined distinction between magecraft and Magic.

findings.highlight: the actions of a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの仕業
findings.governingReading: Rin attributes the field to a Servant’s work.
findings.explanation: Plural actions is mismatched to the singular construction and specific field.

findings.highlight: The rules of humanity.
findings.evidenceJa: 人間としてのルール
findings.governingReading: Rin means the basic rules or restraints one must observe as a human being.
findings.explanation: Rules of humanity sounds like laws governing humankind and obscures the moral norm.

findings.highlight: Trying to comprehend what Tohsaka is saying
findings.evidenceJa: 出来るだけ明確にイメージしようとして
findings.governingReading: Shirou tries to visualize Rin’s warning as clearly as possible.
findings.explanation: Comprehend removes his deliberate construction of the worst image before accepting it.

findings.highlight: I found all the sources of the boundary field
findings.evidenceJa: 結界の基点は全部捜した
findings.governingReading: Rin located every anchor point of the bounded field.
findings.explanation: Sources replaces the technical anchor points and clashes with the singular source in the next sentence.

findings.highlight: the boundary field won’t be activated as long as you’re here?
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂がいるかぎり結界は張られない
findings.governingReading: Shirou incorrectly asks whether Rin’s presence prevents the field from being laid; she then corrects that it is already laid and only activation remains.
findings.explanation: The English silently repairs Shirou’s confusion and erases the setup/set-off distinction taught by Rin’s reply.

findings.highlight: that’s only optimism
findings.evidenceJa: それも都合のいい願いでしょうね
findings.governingReading: Rin calls that a self-serving, convenient hope.
findings.explanation: Optimism removes the criticism that the hope suits what they want to believe.

findings.highlight: The boundary field will be activated even if he does nothing
findings.evidenceJa: あとは黙ってても結界は発動するんだから
findings.governingReading: With the field prepared, the enemy can remain quiet until choosing the moment to activate it.
findings.explanation: The English states automatic activation without action, contradicting the immediately preceding Master-or-Servant trigger condition.

findings.highlight: can’t even give me peace of mind. was pointless.
findings.evidenceJa: 気休めにもならない事を知って
findings.governingReading: Shirou learns that the claim Masters attack only Masters offers no comfort.
findings.explanation: A second discarded predicate remains after the completed sentence.

findings.highlight: anddefeat him completely
findings.evidenceJa: 完膚無きまでに、倒さなければ
findings.governingReading: Shirou repeats that he must find and utterly defeat the responsible Master.
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses and and defeat.

findings.highlight: The end of school homeroom ends
findings.evidenceJa: 帰りのホームルームが終わって
findings.governingReading: After closing homeroom ends, students leave the classroom.
findings.explanation: End is redundantly repeated as both subject and verb.
